newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds to pay foreign income dividend.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds to pay foreign income dividend.

text.p: British chemicals group Courtaulds Plc said on Friday it had decided to pay its final dividend of 11.95 pence a share as a foreign income dividend.
The decision will have to be approved by shareholders at the annual meeting on July 23, the company said.
The company decided this after the new Labour government introduced changes to the regime relating to the taxation of dividends at its budget on July 2.
Courtaulds' foreign income dividend will not be subject to advance corporation tax (ACT) and will thus result in a cash saving of 12 million stg.
Courtaulds is the second company after drinks group Allied Domecq to decide to pay dividend as a foreign income dividend.
A substantial proportion of Courtaulds profits are earned and taxed overseas.
